ui.chat.tags.label: Tags
ui.chat.tags.mode_hint: Tag groups use Time section grouping.
ui.chat.tags.discovery: Right-click a conversation and choose Tags… (Shift+F10, with Fn on most Mac keyboards).
ui.chat.tags.picker_description: Choose tags, then Apply. New tags are saved immediately.
ui.chat.tags.empty: Tags organise conversations without changing their titles. Create a tag to get started.
ui.chat.tags.delete_description: Remove this tag from {count, plural, one {# conversation} other {# conversations}}. Conversations grouped here move to their oldest remaining tag, or Untagged. Conversations will not be deleted.
ui.chat.tags.manage_description: Create, rename and order tags, then Apply. Cancel discards these changes.
ui.chat.tags.save_failed: Tags were not saved. Try again.
ui.chat.tags.load_failed: Tags could not be loaded. Try again.
ui.chat.tags.apply_deletion_first: Apply the deletion first, then add “{name}” again.
ui.chat.tags.remove_all: {count, plural, one {Remove tag (#)} other {Remove all tags (#)}}
ui.chat.tags.move_description: Choose a tag to make it primary, or Untagged to remove all tags.
ui.chat.tags.move_failed: Tags were not moved. Try again.
ui.chat.tags.registry_limit: You can have up to 32 tags
ui.chat.tags.create_failed: Tag was not created. Try again.
ui.chat.tags.remote: Tags cannot be changed on a remote conversation.
ui.chat.tags.registry_changed: Some tags changed elsewhere. Review your selection.
